title: npm audit gate with per-advisory derogations
summary: For Node projects: scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails the gate on any high+ advisory of the lockfiles (NA-1), with an allowlist that accepts one advisory for one package, with a reason and a review date.

NODE_WORKSPACES.prompt: Directories holding a package-lock.json, separated by spaces ("." for the repository root)

postInstall: Run ./scripts/security-checks.sh once with network access: NA-1 audits every lockfile at high+. Fix what it reports; an advisory with no reachable fix gets a justified entry in scripts/audit-allowlist.json.
NA-1 needs the npm registry, so --offline skips it (the pre-push hook included): CI is where it gates. Without the ci-security module, call ./scripts/security-checks.sh from your own workflow.
Add the npm ecosystem of each workspace to .github/dependabot.yml if you use Dependabot.
